an10.26:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate.
an10.26:1.2: atha kho kāḷī upāsikā kuraragharikā yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kāḷī upāsikā kuraragharikā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
an10.26:3.1: imassa nu kho bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti?
an10.26:4.1: paṭhavikasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ.
an10.26:4.2: yāvatā kho bhagini paṭhavī kasiṇasamāpatti paramatā, tadabhiññāsi bhagavā.
an10.26:4.3: tadabhiññāya bhagavā ādimaddasa, ādīnavamaddasa, nissaraṇamaddasa, maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa,
an10.26:4.4: tassa ādi dassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañānadassanahetu atthassa patti, hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
an10.26:5.9: …pe… viññāṇakasiṇasamāpatti paramā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ.
an10.26:5.10: yāvatā kho bhagini viññāṇakasiṇasamāpatti paramatā, tadabhiññāsi bhagavā.
an10.26:5.11: tadabhiññāya bhagavā ādimaddasa, ādīnavamaddasa, nissaraṇamaddasa, maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa,
an10.26:5.12: tassa ādidassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañānadassanahetu atthassa patti, hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
an10.26:5.13: iti kho bhagini yantaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā kumāri pañhesu:
an10.26:7.1: imassa kho bhagini, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
